# [API] opt: Binance API efficiency — pre-fetch candles + batch ticker/price

- Opt 1: Pre-fetch candles for all unique symbols before session loop
  Reduces N API calls to 1 per unique symbol
- Opt 3: Add getTickerPrices() batch function for multiple symbols
  Uses Binance symbols parameter instead of N separate requests

Zero cost optimization. Reduces Binance API weight significantly
when running many concurrent trading sessions.
